context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5.7 Capital Enforcement v2 fully verified. Key features: (1) Portfolio Capital Registry builds snapshot with portfolio_equity, available_capital, allocated_capital, used_margin, risk_budget_total (0.8 ratio), (2) Strategy Capital Allocator uses max=0.20 budget ratio and soft_warning=0.15 with risk_state: NORMAL/WARNING/LIMIT_HIT, (3) Capital Drift Detector emits CAPITAL_BUDGET_DRIFT events with HIGH/MEDIUM severity and detects budget exceed + growth anomaly (>35%), (4) Capital Risk Governor enforces CAPITAL_LIMIT_HIT with REJECT_TRADE action and position_size_multiplier=0, (5) Position Size Policy applies capital_factor + strategy_risk_weight + market_volatility_modifier + cluster_risk_modifier, (6) Capital Order Guard rejects trades exceeding budget (CAPITAL_TRADE_REJECTED), reduces size on warning, aligns with cluster risk, (7) Capital Governance Audit builds CAPITAL_LIMIT_HIT/CAPITAL_BUDGET_DRIFT/CAPITAL_TRADE_REJECTED/CAPITAL_REALLOCATION events. Frontend page at /admin/futures/capital-governance with data-testid=nav-admin-futures-capital-governance-link for navigation. UI shows: summary cards (equity/available/risk_budget/drift_alerts), allocation panel, usage bars with visual progress, drift alerts list, drift monitor by strategy.
